"It works" is useful feedback too. For a problem, add **debug** logs as described in the bug report template.

## Versions

- Pre-release [e.g. v4.7.0.16]
- Version before [e.g. v4.7.0.15]
- Home Assistant Core Version [e.g. 2026.10.3]
- Installation method [e.g. Home Assistant OS / Docker / HA Green]

## Result

- [ ] Works as expected
- [ ] Problem, described below

## What I tested

What the release notes asked for, and how long it ran.

## Problem

What happened, and what you expected to happen.

## Logs

``` text
Debug logs here
```

## Going back

- [ ] Not needed
- [ ] Went back to the version before, and it works again
- [ ] Went back, and something is still wrong (describe above)
